what: Plan changes the /upgrade-larch install-stamp trust model but only updates the sibling script doc. SECURITY.md still says prune does not write stamps from mtimes and stamps only verified or already-latest stable dirs; installation docs say legacy unstamped dirs fall back to mtime at ranking time only.
scenario_or_breakage: After this PR, canonical security/user docs would contradict the implemented behavior for unverified install stamping and mtime backfill.
suggested_fix: Keep the implementation scope narrow, but add targeted updates to SECURITY.md and docs/installation-and-setup.md for Change 2 and Change 3, or drop Change 3/unstable stamping if the two-file constraint is meant to remain binding.
